overview.description: The Proshares Ultra QQQ Equal Weight ETF (EQQQ) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the NASDAQ-100 Equally Weighted index. The fund seeks daily investment results corresponding to two times (2x) the performance of the Nasdaq-100 Equal Weighted Index, before fees and expenses. The index measures the performance of the largest non-financial companies listed on Nasdaq on an equal-weight basis. EQQQ was launched on Jul 21, 2026 and is issued by ProShares.
